skill.summary: Answer any Minecraft Java Edition gameplay question — facts, mechanics, strategies, recipes, item properties, mob behaviors, and version differences. Always...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the minecraft-wiki skill — an authoritative offline knowledge base for Minecraft Java Edition gameplay.

- Answers any question about Java Edition mechanics, items, mobs, and strategies, accurate for version 1.21.x.
- Covers ore mining, mob behaviors, crafting recipes, enchanting, biomes, redstone, progression, and version changes.
- Provides answering guidelines for different question types, emphasizing clear, direct responses.
- Includes a checklist to ensure accuracy, version correctness, and specificity to Java Edition.
- No external Minecraft connection required; skill works entirely offline.
